title: Probing the Nature of High-redshift Weak Emission Line Quasars: A Young Quasar with a Starburst Host Galaxy
question: What is the nature of the weak emission line quasar PSO J083+11 at z=6.34 (young quasar vs lensing vs soft continuum), and what are the properties of its host galaxy from ALMA [C II] and dust continuum?

recipe.goal: Fit GNIRS spectrum and derive black hole mass, Eddington ratio and line properties
recipe.method: Multi-component fit (power law + UV Fe II continuum, single Gaussian broad lines) with a modified PyQSOFit; Mg II virial mass from the single-epoch scaling relation; L_bol = 5.15 x lambda L_3000
key_parameters: Bolometric correction L_bol = 5.15 x lambda L_3000 (Richards et al. 2006)
assumptions: Virial theorem valid for the BLR dynamics; systematic mass errors ~0.5 dex not included

recipe.goal: Measure weak-line equivalent widths, proximity zone size and quasar lifetime
recipe.method: Integrate flux above power-law continuum in 1160-1290 A (Ly-alpha+N V) and 1500-1600 A (C IV upper limit); proximity zone from continuum-normalized FIRE spectrum; lifetime from radiative transfer simulations
key_parameters: FIRE spectrum continuum-normalized and convolved with a 20 A boxcar kernel; proximity zone edge where transmitted flux first drops below 10%

recipe.goal: Test gravitational lensing with HST imaging
recipe.method: PSF subtraction using eight field stars (Photutils); aperture photometry of foreground emission; BAGPIPES SED model of the foreground galaxy to get stellar mass; point-mass lens to bound Einstein angle and magnification
key_parameters: Uniform priors on M_formed = 10^(1-15) Msun and T_0 = 0.5-0.8 Gyr
assumptions: Delayed exponentially declining SFH, tau = 0.3 Gyr, solar metallicity Z=0.02, log(U) = -3, A_V = 1.0 mag (Calzetti law); star-forming main sequence galaxy; mass-to-light ratio upper limit ~100

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image the ALMA Band 6 data
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration in CASA, then tclean with natural weighting, cleaning down to 2-sigma in a 5'' circular region around the quasar
key_parameters: natural weighting to maximize point source sensitivity

recipe.goal: Subtract continuum and make [C II] cubes
recipe.method: Mask line channels, median continuum model, subtract from visibilities, image cubes
key_parameters: 30 MHz channel width; beam ~0.42'' x 0.37''; rms ~0.24 mJy/beam

recipe.goal: Extract [C II] spectrum and fit line flux, FWHM and redshift
recipe.method: Spectrum from a 1.5'' radius aperture (8.3 kpc); aperture flux scaled by epsilon = C/(D-R) applied to the dirty image flux; Gaussian fit

recipe.goal: Make dust continuum maps and measure flux densities
recipe.method: Select line-free channels in each spectral window, collapse to moment-zero maps, measure flux in the same 1.5'' aperture
key_parameters: effective bandwidth of ~2500 km/s per spectral window

recipe.goal: Make [C II] moment maps and measure sizes and velocity structure
recipe.method: Moment 0 over 700 km/s (3 x FWHM); moment 1 and 2 maps; sizes from 2D Gaussian fits to continuum and [C II] emission
key_parameters: 700 km/s collapse width equals 3 x [C II] FWHM

recipe.goal: Derive [C II] luminosity and [C II]-based SFR
recipe.method: L[CII] from Carilli & Walter formula; SFR from the De Looze et al. L[CII] scaling relation with a factor ~2.5 systematic uncertainty
assumptions: SFR-L[CII] relation calibrated for z>5 galaxies applied to the quasar host

recipe.goal: Model dust SED for dust mass, L_FIR, L_TIR and SFR_TIR
recipe.method: Modified blackbody scaled to the 244 and 258 GHz flux densities, with CMB correction; SED integrated for L_FIR (42.5-122.5 um) and L_TIR (3-1100 um); SFR from L_TIR relation with factor 3 systematic uncertainty
assumptions: T_dust = 47 K, beta = 1.6 fixed; low dust optical depth in Rayleigh-Jeans regime; dust mass has at least a factor of two systematic uncertainty from the opacity scaling
